visual_identity.pattern_strategy: Dappled 'Fawn-like' spots in pale lavender-grey across the back; no counter-shading, running uniformly across its horizontal lateral flank.
visual_identity.integument: Soft, dolphin-like skin with high specular highlights, mapped cleanly along its horizontal profile.
visual_identity.facial_silhouette: Strict side-profile view configured to display the animal's maximum horizontal length for accurate top-by-bottom size comparisons. The tiny, delicate head is oriented perfectly to face laterally, with its bird-like beady eye and needle-thin teeth aligned parallel to the camera plane.

pose: The classic plesiosaur is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original extreme S-curve neck pose and forward camera-facing gaze are unrolled and stabilized into a flat, level, straight cruising path, extending its delicate head, long neck, compact torso, flippers (flattened toward the camera plane), and tail end-to-end to cleanly track alongside the central UI measuring tape system.
